committee: All20 checkpoints of this single run, including the candidate itself
normalization: ASCII letters case-insensitive; digits exact; no letter-digit equivalence
positions: Left-aligned zero-based positions; width=max predicted length per image; no label-derived lengths or edit alignment
missing: Missing/non-alphanumeric characters cannot form keys; count among20 voters; missing candidate is a mismatch at a keyed position
disputed: Skip positions without an alphanumeric character supported by at least11/20
score: Total matching keyed positions divided by total keyed positions; same denominator for every epoch; no penalty at skipped positions
primary_accuracy: Case-sensitive exact whole-string accuracy, read only after selection freeze
interpretation: Retrospective diagnostic on repeatedly inspected historical test; consensus is not correctness; fixed-final20 official choice unchanged
